# NegotiationAwareRouting

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network routing strategy that incorporates multi-agent service-level negotiations (e.g., price, QoS, trust) into path selection decisions. Bridges service-layer objectives with topology-level constraints, enabling in-network neuromorphic controllers to make routing decisions that satisfy both performance and business logic.
